title.zh: 原子为什么会粘在一起

desc.zh: 钻石硬、石墨滑、盐一敲就碎、铜能拉成丝、水到 100 °C 才开，原因都在同一件事里：电子在几个原子核之间怎么待着。这篇从盒子里的一个电子讲起，用真实的方程算出 H₂⁺ 的键、苯的能级、食盐的晶格能、能带和带隙、分子间力和一个会熔化会沸腾的小模拟，再到蛋白质折叠和 2026 年的前沿。
desc.en: Diamond is hard, graphite is slippery, salt shatters, copper draws into wire and water boils only at 100 °C, all for one reason: how electrons sit between atomic nuclei. This essay starts from one electron in a box and uses the real equations to compute the bond in H₂⁺, the levels of benzene, the lattice energy of table salt, bands and band gaps, the forces between molecules and a small simulation that melts and boils, then goes on to protein folding and the frontier as of 2026.

title.zh: 关得越紧动能越高：盒子里的电子
title.en: Confinement costs kinetic energy: the particle in a box

desc.zh: 电子被关在宽 L 的盒子里，最低动能是 h²/8mL²；范围宽一倍，动能降到四分之一，这是化学键的第一个来源。
desc.en: An electron confined to a box of width L has a minimum kinetic energy h²/8mL²; doubling the width cuts it to a quarter, the first source of chemical bonding.

zh: 电子为什么不掉进原子核
en: why doesn't the electron fall into the nucleus

title.zh: H₂⁺ 与原子轨道线性组合
title.en: H₂⁺ and the linear combination of atomic orbitals

desc.zh: 两个质子共用一个电子：把两个 1s 轨道相加或相减，用解析积分算出成键和反键的能量曲线，最低点给出键长和键能。
desc.en: Two protons sharing one electron: add or subtract two 1s orbitals and the closed-form integrals give bonding and antibonding energy curves whose minimum is the bond length and bond energy.

zh: 原子为什么会粘在一起
势能曲线 键长 键能

title.en: Filling molecular orbitals and bond order

desc.zh: 成键电子数减反键电子数再除以二就是键级：H₂ 是 1，He₂ 是 0，所以氦不成分子。
desc.en: Bond order is half the difference between bonding and antibonding electrons: 1 for H₂, 0 for He₂, which is why helium forms no molecule.

zh: σ 轨道和 σ* 轨道

title.zh: Hückel 模型、离域能与芳香性
title.en: The Hückel model, delocalisation energy and aromaticity

desc.zh: 把共轭分子写成一张只管连接的矩阵，特征值就是 π 轨道能量：苯的离域能是 2|β|，4n+2 个 π 电子的环特别稳定。
desc.en: Write a conjugated molecule as a connectivity matrix and its eigenvalues are the π orbital energies: benzene has 2|β| of delocalisation energy and rings with 4n+2 π electrons are especially stable.

zh: 反芳香性 环丁二烯
胡萝卜为什么是橙色的
en: why do conjugated molecules have color

title.zh: 从共价键到离子键：电负性与极性
title.en: From covalent to ionic: electronegativity and polarity

desc.zh: 两个原子的能量差 Δ 相对跳跃 β 越大，共用的电子越偏向一边；共价键和离子键是同一把尺子的两头。
desc.en: The larger the energy difference Δ between two atoms relative to the hopping β, the more the shared electrons lean to one side; covalent and ionic bonds are two ends of one scale.

zh: 共价键和离子键的区别
电负性差多少算离子键
HCl 是离子键还是共价键

title.zh: 马德隆常数、晶格能与玻恩–哈伯循环
title.en: Madelung constant, lattice energy and the Born–Haber cycle

desc.zh: 把整块食盐晶体的静电一层层加起来得到 1.7476；由此算出的晶格能 −753 kJ/mol 与玻恩–哈伯循环绕出来的 −787 只差 4%。
desc.en: Summing the electrostatics of a whole salt crystal shell by shell gives 1.7476; the lattice energy it yields, −753 kJ/mol, is within 4% of the −787 from the Born–Haber cycle.

title.zh: 能带与带隙：导体、半导体、绝缘体
title.en: Energy bands and the band gap: conductors, semiconductors, insulators

desc.zh: N 个原子有 N 条能级，原子极多时连成能带；带是半满还是隔着带隙，决定导电、绝缘和透明与否。
desc.en: N atoms give N levels that merge into a band; whether the band is half full or separated by a gap decides conduction, insulation and transparency.

zh: 半导体和绝缘体的区别
导体半导体绝缘体的区别

title.zh: 电子对互斥与杂化轨道

desc.zh: 电子对互相躲开决定分子形状；杂化是描述这个形状的记账方式，两条 spⁿ 轨道的夹角满足 cos θ = −1/n。
desc.en: Electron pairs avoiding each other set a molecule's shape; hybridisation is bookkeeping for that shape, with cos θ = −1/n between two spⁿ hybrids.

zh: 甲烷为什么是正四面体
硫化氢键角为什么是 92 度

title.zh: 分子间作用力：色散力、偶极力、氢键
title.en: Intermolecular forces: dispersion, dipole and hydrogen bonds

desc.zh: 分子之间的吸引只有零点几到几十 kJ/mol，和室温的 kT（2.5 kJ/mol）相比谁大，决定一样东西是气、液还是固。
desc.en: Attractions between molecules are only tenths to tens of kJ/mol; how they compare with kT at room temperature (2.5 kJ/mol) decides whether a substance is gas, liquid or solid.

title.en: The Lennard-Jones potential and molecular dynamics

desc.zh: 一条势能曲线加牛顿第二定律：48 个原子自己排成晶体、熔化成液滴、蒸发成气体。
desc.en: One potential curve plus Newton's second law: 48 atoms crystallise, melt into a droplet and evaporate on their own.

en: microscopic picture of melting and boiling

title.zh: 结构决定性质：金刚石、石墨、金属、陶瓷
title.en: Structure decides properties: diamond, graphite, metals, ceramics

desc.zh: 同样的原子连法不同就是不同的材料：看最弱的连接是什么、朝哪个方向。
desc.en: The same atoms bonded differently are different materials: look at what the weakest link is and which way it points.

desc.zh: N 节的自由连接链两头平均只隔 √N 节；拉直它减少的是摆法而不是能量，所以橡皮筋是熵的弹簧。
desc.en: A freely jointed chain of N links spans only √N links on average; stretching it removes arrangements, not energy, so a rubber band is an entropic spring.

zh: 橡皮筋受热为什么收缩
en: why does a rubber band shrink when heated

title.zh: 蛋白质折叠、Levinthal 佯谬与 HP 模型
title.en: Protein folding, Levinthal's paradox and the HP model

desc.zh: 蛋白质只靠弱力把自己折成确定的形状；在方格上的 HP 模型里可以亲手折一条链，并和穷举出的最低能量比较。
desc.en: A protein folds into a definite shape using only weak forces; in the HP lattice model the reader folds a chain by hand and compares with the exhaustively found ground state.

zh: 鸡蛋为什么煮熟了变不回去
镰刀型贫血 蛋白质
en: why do eggs turn white when cooked

title.zh: 电子结构计算的前沿：DFT、机器学习势、AlphaFold、材料生成
title.en: The frontier of electronic-structure calculation: DFT, ML potentials, AlphaFold, generative materials

desc.zh: 越准的方法越贵（DFT 是 N³，CCSD(T) 是 N⁷）；截至 2026 年 11 月，机器学习在准和大之间搭桥，哪些已验证、哪些只是声称分开列出。
desc.en: More accurate methods cost more (DFT N³, CCSD(T) N⁷); as of November 2026 machine learning bridges accuracy and size, with what is verified and what is only claimed listed separately.

zh: AI 发现新材料 是真的吗

title.zh: 看一样材料先问四件事
title.en: Four questions to ask of any material

desc.zh: 最强的连接、最弱的连接、弱的连接朝哪边、电子有没有空位：四个问题读出一样东西的脾气。
desc.en: Strongest link, weakest link, which way the weak link points, whether electrons have empty states: four questions that read off a material's character.
